title: Astronaut Hip Bone Loss Outpaces the Rest
hook: Floating hits the bones that carry your weight hardest.
closing: Long missions need countermeasures because weight-bearing bones lose the loading that keeps them strong.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5 percent monthly. Removing normal loading makes loss arrive on a much faster clock.
Hip bone density can drop 2.2 percent monthly. Weight-bearing bone takes the hardest hit.
An unmitigated Mars estimate reaches 30 percent hip bone loss. That is a projection, not a completed mission result.
